subject: Go-to-Market pod formation: request for 4 hires and comp band guidance
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Sep 2024 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Go-to-Market pod formation: request for 4 hires and comp band guidance

Team —

I’m proposing a small, focused pod to accelerate coverage in the Mid-Market East region starting in Oct. Plan is to add 4 roles: 2 Account Executives (AE), 1 Customer Success Manager (CSM), and 1 Solutions Engineer (SE). Goal: close deals in the $75k–$250k range while maintaining ramp velocity.

Asks:
- Approval to open the four reqs in People Ops this week.
- Guidance from Marissa on comp bands for AE/CSM/SE (we want to be competitive but within the Q4 hiring envelope).
- Ben/Monica: any headcount or quota modeling constraints I should be aware of (CAC impact, OTE mix)?

Summary bullets attached (headcount_rollup_2024Q4.xlsx) and a short quota model (pod_level_quota_modeling.pdf). I’ll sync with Rebecca at Talent Partners to prioritize sourcing once we have approvals.

Proposed hiring cadence: post roles Sep 18; first interviews Sep 30; offers by Oct 10; start dates late Oct/early Nov.

If we need to compress, we can hire 1 AE + CSM first and backfill the SE.

Thanks —
Karthik
Director, Solutions GTM
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Sep 2024 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Go-to-Market pod formation: request for 4 hires and comp band guidance

Karthik —

Thanks for the concise plan. A few quick thoughts:

1) Comp bands: for Q4 we should target the following ranges to stay inside our current comp envelope: AE (Base 85–95k, OTE 160–190k), CSM (Base 80–90k, OTE 120–140k), SE (Base 120–140k, OTE 170–200k). I’ll share a short comp sheet separately that maps to our grade bands.

2) Headcount prioritization: given limited recruiting capacity, I’d prioritize 1 AE + 1 SE + 1 CSM (3 hires) this quarter and hold the second AE as a Q1 need unless pipeline acceleration justifies the fourth hire immediately.

3) Finance check: need Ben to confirm the incremental quota load and uplift assumptions before I sign off on posting all four. If Ben can’t confirm by EOD Thu we should go with 3 hires in this quarter.

Also, include Monica in the interview panel for the SE — her feedback on technical fit is important.

-Marissa
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Sep 2024 11:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Go-to-Market pod formation: request for 4 hires and comp band guidance

Quick finance take —

I ran the incremental quota and ACV uplift in the attached modeling doc (pod_level_quota_modeling.pdf). Highlights:
- If we hire 3 heads this quarter (1 AE / 1 CSM / 1 SE) we project a blended payback of ~7.2 months on incremental bookings after 6 months of ramp.
- Hiring the second AE this quarter improves 12-month incremental revenue by ~22% but increases quarterly burn by ~21%.
- We have headroom within the Q4 hiring commitment up to 3.4 FTE equivalents (after contractor conversions). Approving a 4th role would require a reallocation from other teams or an overcommit - possible but needs exec sign-off.

Recommendation: approve 3 hires now. Approve the second AE conditional on showing +15% pipeline carry into Oct.

Ben
Head of Finance Planning
Redwood Inference

Attachment: pod_level_quota_modeling.pdf (see sheet 'scenario_B')

From: Rebecca Shaw <rebecca@talentpartners.co>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Sep 2024 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Go-to-Market pod formation: request for 4 hires and comp band guidance

Thanks for the heads up — Rebecca from Talent Partners here.

We can start sourcing immediately for the 3-role cadence Marissa/Ben recommended: AE (Mid-Market, 3–6 yrs, quota-carrying), CSM (post-sale motion, renewal/expansion), SE (pre-sales, strong python/infra background preferred). I’ll prioritize candidates currently open to travel (given east-region coverage).

Two quick asks from our side:
- Do you have a mandatory take-home assessment for SE? If so, share rubric; if not, we’ll propose a 90-minute technical screen + panel.
- Interview loop: please confirm panels for each role (we suggest Karthik + Monica for SE; Marissa + a sales director for AE; Monica + a CSM manager for CSM).

I’ll enqueue the reqs and share 4–6 candidate profiles within 7 business days once you confirm.

Best,
Rebecca Shaw
Senior Talent Partner
Talent Partners Co.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Rebecca Shaw <rebecca@talentpartners.co>
Date: Wed, 18 Sep 2024 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Go-to-Market pod formation: request for 4 hires and comp band guidance

Thanks, everyone — quick recap and next steps: 

- Approved for Q4: open reqs for 1 AE, 1 CSM, 1 SE. (Second AE deferred to Q1 unless pipeline threshold met.)
- Marissa: please push the AE/CSM/SE grade-band mapping to People Ops; Ben’s scenario_B looks good.
- Monica: you’ll co-own the SE interview loop; Rebecca will send candidate shortlist by next Wednesday.
- Rebecca: please use the proposed loop and prioritize candidates who can start by Nov.

I uploaded an updated headcount_rollup_2024Q4.xlsx (tab 'Pod East') and linked the Drive doc: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcdExamplePodPlan.

If there are no objections by Friday EOD I’ll ask People Ops to post the three reqs.

Karthik
Director, Solutions GTM
Redwood Inference
